description: Next-occurrence conformance vectors. from = current due date (fixed) or completion date (after_completion). anchor = original due date, used for interval-week phase.

vectors.name: daily_across_dst_spring_forward
vectors.why: Floating local dates: DST is invisible to date-level math. Europe/Berlin jumps 2026-03-29.

vectors.name: weekday_skips_weekend
vectors.why: 2026-07-03 is a Friday; next weekday is Monday.

vectors.name: weekly_mon_wed_fri_midweek
vectors.why: From Monday, next scheduled is Wednesday.

vectors.name: weekly_single_day_wraps_week
vectors.why: Saturday task completed on its day rolls a full week.

vectors.name: biweekly_phase_from_anchor
vectors.why: Every 2 weeks on Tuesday, anchored 2026-07-07 (ISO week 28): next qualifying week is 30.

vectors.name: monthly_day_31_clamps_to_feb_end
vectors.why: Clamp to last day of shorter month; stored rule keeps monthday 31.

vectors.name: monthly_recovers_from_clamp
vectors.why: Clamping is per-occurrence; the 31st rule resumes in longer months.

vectors.name: after_completion_from_completion_date
vectors.why: Task was due 2026-07-05 but completed late on 2026-07-10; every! 3 days counts from completion.

vectors.name: fixed_overdue_still_advances_from_due
vectors.why: Fixed mode ignores completion date: next Monday after the due Monday.
